steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to a reverse auction using a price-based auction configuration.
Apply the available reverse-auction pricing template so the product sheet is rendered.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Attempt to enter a location that is not a valid company plant.
